integrity: Computational certificate uses exact integer graph induction; the absence-of-periodic-points proof uses a recurrent tower exhaustion, not finite orbit sampling. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the seven cyclic translations of seven equal intervals; periodic-period spectra and full basins in nonergodic cases not determined. Novelty restricted to available inspected evidence.
title: The seven cyclic rotated odometers: an exact ergodic–periodic dichotomy
